step: Patients with an index NSCLC diagnosis
Advanced disease (stage IV at diagnosis or later distant metastasis)
Received >=1 systemic regimen for advanced disease
First-line regimen is anti-PD-(L)1 monotherapy or anti-PD-(L)1 + platinum chemotherapy (non-trial, non-investigational)
STK11 and KEAP1 evaluable on a covering NGS panel (any time)
No sensitising EGFR mutation or ALK/ROS1 fusion detected
Valid overall-survival follow-up after time zero
Under observation after NGS report (delayed entry)
